name: Onboarding Tour page: the seeded tour of the demo repo, its notices and its five sections
description: Deterministic (no model call) walk through the read-only Onboarding Tour page on the seeded demo repo acme/payments-api. Opens it from the sidebar; the header shows 'Onboarding for', the stored index size ('12,450 files', formatted en-US) and 'last refreshed'; the seeded 'partial' index row and the indexed sha that differs from the tour's commit make the 'Built from a partial index' and 'Repo changed since this tour' notices appear, next to the 'Regenerate' and 'Share link' buttons. The five section titles and the 'On this page' nav are present; each section's seeded content is present (collapsed bodies use 'hidden', so their text stays in the DOM): the summary chip, the critical path with its note and its 'Open … on GitHub' link, the run command with 'Copy command 4', the reading-path reason and the first-task title. The flow never clicks Regenerate, Generate tour, Share link or any Copy button, and the GitHub link is only focused, not followed. Absence, order, focus and collapse checks, and the clipboard, live in the component tests (agent-browser has no 'is absent' wait). Finally opens /onboarding and waits for 'Add a repository' (the add-repo screen is unchanged; 06-onboarding.flow.json covers it in depth). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (server/src/db/seed-onboarding.ts); reads only, so it can run in any order.
